name: io.github.kfx2026/sanyu-research
title: SanYu Research Engine
description: 106 deterministic medical research tools (not LLM guessing): ROC/AUC + DeLong, survival KM/Cox, Table 1, sample size, PSM, DEG, GO/KEGG enrichment, PPI, primer design, literature search. Every response carries engine_status (real / unavailable / error) and data_source so results are auditable. Failed calls are never charged. Three tools (act_sequence_translate, act_sequence_orf, act_roc) run without an API key for evaluation.
